title: A goal's state after one transition: its phase, the cause when it failed, and the attempt and round in progress

goal.description: The goal, by its contract's path in the ledger.

phase.description: Where the goal is: not yet started, waiting on its dependencies, being built, its commit being collected, the panel judging, a round failed, the supervisor deciding what follows, passed, landing, delivered for the operator's merge, merged, failed on a cause, or dropped.

cause.description: Why the goal failed, when it did: a tool call outside the limits was refused, a child's sandbox was lost, a child hit its deadline, idle or budget bound, its work was left unstaged or was not one commit or failed a check command, the remote's tip was not the pushed commit, a seat returned no structured vote, the panel failed the round, two rounds repeated the same findings, the operator denied the budget, or the goal was stopped.

attempt.description: The attempt in progress, by its path in the ledger, while one is.

round.description: The round in progress, by its path in the ledger, while one is.
